# Rough grammar generated by ChatGPT

```
program
    ::= statement* EOF
```

> A program is zero or more statements followed by the end of the file.

## Statements
```
statement ::=
    variable_declaration
    | function_declaration
    | return_statement
    | while_statement
    | if_statement
    | expression_statement
    | block
```

### Variable Declaration
```
variable_declaration
    ::= "var" IDENTIFIER ":" type "=" expression ";"

(If initialization is optional)
variable_declaration
    ::= "var" IDENTIFIER ":" type ("=" expression)? ";"
```

### Function Declaration
```
function_declaration
    ::= "fn" IDENTIFIER "(" parameters? ")" ":" type block
```

> 
> ```
> parameters
>     ::= parameter ( "," parameter )*
> parameter
>     ::= IDENTIFIER ":" type
> ```
### Return Statement
```
return_statement
    ::= "return" expression? ";"
```

### While Statement
```
while_statement
    ::= "while" "(" expression ")" block
```

### If Statement
```
if_statement
    ::= "if" "(" expression ")" block
        ("else" block)?
```

### Block
```
block
    ::= "{" statement* "}"

```
> Important note that it is comprised of statements, not expressions

## Expressions

> "recursive-descent parsers usually write one rule per precedence level."

### Lowest Precedence
```
expression
    ::= logical_or
```

### Logical Or
```
logical_or
    ::= logical_and ( "||" logical_and )*
```
> "Meaning `a || b || c` is parsed as repeated logical_ands joined by ||."


### Logical And
```
logical_and
    ::= equality ( "&&" equality )*
```

### Equality
```
equality
    ::= comparison ( ("==" | "!=") comparison )*
```

### Comparison
```
comparison
    ::= addition
        ( ("<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") addition )*
```

### Addition
```
addition
    ::= multiplication
        ( ("+" | "-") multiplication )*
```

### Multiplication
```
multiplication
    ::= unary
        ( ("*" | "/") unary )*
```

### Unary
```
unary
    ::= ("!" | "-") unary
     | call
```

### Function Call
```
call
    ::= primary ( "(" arguments? ")" )*
```
> "The * means calls can chain. `foo()(1)` if your language eventually allows it."

### Arguments
```
arguments
    ::= expression ( "," expression )*
```

### Primary Expressions
```
primary
    ::= INTEGER
     | FLOAT
     | STRING
     | "true"
     | "false"
     | IDENTIFIER
     | "(" expression ")"
```
> "These are the leaves of the AST"


## Types
```
type
    ::= "int"
     | "float"
     | "bool"
     | "String"
     | "void"
```
> "Later this might become
> ```
> type
>    ::= IDENTIFIER
> ```
> to support user-defined types."
